# Jack Pitts

> Jack Pitts co-founded Salt Creek Advisory with his brother, Connor Pitts. Salt Creek Advisory is a family-owned, Chicago-based investment bank that represents owners of family- and founder-owned businesses in the lower middle market when they sell their companies. It works on the sell side only.

Jack also hosts two podcasts, The Making Of Hosted by Jack Pitts and Lower Middle Market Brief, writes on Substack, and built HelmIQ, the deal CRM Salt Creek runs on.

Contact: jack@saltcreekadvisory.com
Instagram: @thejackpitts (Jack), @saltcreekadvisory (the firm)
